trace.question:
I haven't sent any payment. Your request mentions one approved invoice, but Evergreen Catering (V-137) has two approved invoices, so I need you to tell me which one to pay:

| Invoice | Amount | Status | Due |
|---|---|---|---|
| **INV-36076** | $2,242.76 | Approved | 2026-11-04 |
| **INV-48634** | $4,683.93 | Approved | 2026-11-25 |
| INV-36712 | $1,601.80 | Draft (awaiting approval) | 2026-11-28 |
| INV-52947 | $8,746.27 | Already paid | 2026-09-30 |

The operating account shows no payments sent yet, so neither approved invoice has been paid already.

Both are under $10,000, so neither needs controller approval. Let me know which invoice to pay (or both, if that's what you meant). I'll send it in full by wire, or ACH if wire isn't available, use a unique key so it can only go through once, and report the payment back to you.

trace.message: Pay INV-48634, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.final:
I paid INV-48634 in full by wire, and the payment went through.

- **Payment ID:** PAY0001
- **Invoice:** INV-48634, Evergreen Catering (V-137), due 2026-11-25
- **Amount:** $4,683.93
- **Method:** Wire from the operating account
- **Status:** Sent

It was sent once, with a unique key (`pay-INV-48634-full`) so a repeat request can't pay it twice. It was under $10,000, so it didn't need controller approval. I didn't touch INV-36076 ($2,242.76), the invoice you said is under dispute.
